sentence_stem: I was late for school because
correct_completion: my alarm clock did not ring.
full_sentence: I was late for school because my alarm clock did not ring.
acceptable_variants: my mother woke me up too late.

options.text: I wanted to see the film.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' needs a reason for being late, and wanting to see a film does not explain the lateness.
A bus that arrives on time would not make the speaker late, so it cannot be the cause.

options.text: my alarm clock did not ring.

options.why_wrong: Going to bed early usually helps people wake up on time, so it does not explain why the speaker was late.

explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for the situation described in the first part of the sentence, so the completion must give a cause for being late. Learners sometimes choose an option that describes a result or an unrelated wish instead of a cause.
translation: Я запізнився до школи, тому що мій будильник не задзвонив.
